newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to delay restart of 140,000 bpd topper.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to delay restart of 140,000 bpd topper.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Friday that it would bring a 140,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Negishi refinery back on line on November 1, four days later than originally scheduled.
The topper has been shut down since September 18 for routine maintenance, and delays in the work had held up the restart, a Nippon Oil spokesman said.
The Negishi refinery, located near Tokyo, is Japan's largest with a total capacity of 385,000 bpd.
